notes.title: August 29th Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders  

We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on August 29. The estimated update time is 8 hours. 

Update Contents: 

I. New Metal Maidens:

1. JPz Marder, obtainable through:

- Direct drop from the Targeted Forge.

- Exchange for Sniper Eyepatches obtained from the Forge Event.

- Exchange for Vouchers.

2. Object 450 (N6 medium tank), obtainable through R&D.



II. Targeted Forge Event

During the event period, there will be two forge pools for the following tanks:

1. Garage Key (new item)

2. JPz Marder (new metal maiden)

Both can be obtained by chance through direct pulls on the event forges, or exchanged with corresponding event items collected.

JPz Marder can also be bought from the event store using Vouchers.

The event item for the Garage Key is Prototype Glycerin, and the event item for JPz Marder is Sniper Eyepatch. Both are obtainable through their respective forge pools.

During the event period, AB Bombs can be exchanged for Prototype Glycerins for a limited number of times.

Commanders who have the Petrov Warrant active can obtain a number of Prototype Glycerins pieces by pressing the Time-limited Award button on the Hunting Missions’ Award screen.

The two event items can also be exchanged for the following rewards:

Prototype Glycerin: 1x Marching Rucksack (Limited to 1 time)

Sniper Eyepatch: 1x Fate Pin (Limited to 1 time)

A Marching Rucksack contains:

2x Fate Pin

450x of each: Wreck, Secret Plan, Processor, Test Doll

36,000x Codon

210x Second-hand Material

10x Occult Jellyfish

The G-Iron forge pool (Pool 1), which previously had a chance to drop a metal maiden, will now drop a new item instead: the Garage Key. The Garage Key can be used in the exchange shop to redeem 1x Marching Rucksack (limited to 1 time) or a metal maiden from Pool 1 of a previous Targeted Forge event.



III. Microtransaction events

1. Energy Cubes from purchasing Gold

During the event period, purchasing gold will grant Energy Cubes.

Purchasing a Small Bag of Gold grants 54 Energy Cubes.

Purchasing a Big Bag of Gold grants 102 Energy Cubes.

Purchasing a Small Box of Gold grants 262 Energy Cubes.

Purchasing a Big Box of Gold grants 518 Energy Cubes.

In the Depot, tap on Energy Cubes to open their exchange shop which offers various materials.

Energy Cubes can be exchanged for Gold and G-Iron (for a limited number of times), Dogtags and Mutated Corn.

2. Loyalty Coins from purchasing Gold

During the event period, purchasing gold will grant Loyalty Coins.

Purchasing a Small Bag of Gold grants 17 Loyalty Coins.

Purchasing a Big Bag of Gold grants 33 Loyalty Coins.

Purchasing a Small Box of Gold grants 84 Loyalty Coins.

Purchasing a Big Box of Gold grants 64 Confidential Files.

In the Depot, tap on the Confidential Files to exchange them for desired materials in the corresponding shops.

notes.title: July 30th Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders 

We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on July 30. The estimated update time is 8 hours. 

Update contents:

I. New metal maidens:

1. Object 1200, obtainable through the Glutton on a Palm event.

2. Pz.Kl.Zerstörer Rutscher, obtainable through:

- Feeding Epsilon in the Glutton on a Palm event (very low chance).

- Exchange for Crystal Shells.

3. Radkampfwagen 90, obtainable through R&D.

4. T-62M, obtainable by purchasing the Summer Limited Special Elite Pack.

P.S. Please note, after the update, unpurchased Spring limited packs will be removed.

II. Glutton on a Palm event

Portia has asked Commanders to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of Farers’ physiology and to refine her existing databases.

Epsilon will rate the items you feed her differently, and you will receive corresponding rewards.

After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.

Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the final reward for this event.

This time, the reward is Object 1200.

Epsilon’s maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. As a result, the difficulty of achieving the necessary satisfaction level has been drastically reduced!

All the changes made to the event are as follows:

1. The indigestion mechanic has been removed, so Epsilon can be fed continuously.

2. An auto-feeding system has been added, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.

3. There is a chance to obtain Crystal Shells each time Epsilon is fed. The probability and number of Crystal Shells obtained depend on the item that’s being used.

4. If Epsilon is fed Architecture Blueprints, aside from getting high satisfaction, she will also drop a single guaranteed piece of Incomplete Intelligence. However, you will not get any other items.

Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:

1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events

2. Limited edition resource packs

3. A metal maiden: Pz.Kl.Zerstörer Rutscher (Requires Sky Steel system to be unlocked).

Pz.Kl.Zerstörer Rutscher can also be obtained directly from feeding Epsilon (very low chance; requires Sky Steel system to be unlocked). Please note this is an extra bonus, so we advise against trying excessively for this specific drop.

Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.

We advise new commanders to avoid feeding large amounts of S1 equipment, as this may hinder their overall progression. If you need Crystal Shells, consider exchanging Vouchers for them. The most efficient way to obtain Gold for Vouchers is by purchasing the M-Supply.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event

During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.

This special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool is an optimized version of the G-Iron Blasting Pool, with an increased drop rate for advanced equipment.

P.S. This iteration of the Intelligence Deciphering event will not feature specific milestone rewards; it serves as a dedicated channel for acquiring advanced equipment.

The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses Incomplete Intelligence, which can be obtained through the following methods:

1. Guaranteed obtaining when feeding Epsilon with Architecture Blueprints in the Glutton on a Palm event.

2. The exchange for Club Vouchers in the event store.

3. The exchange for Tanghulu in the event store, for a limited number of times.

4. The exchange for Crystal Shells in the event store, for a limited number of times.

5. The exchange for G-SiSe in the event store, for a limited number of times.

6. As a one-time reward from missions after clearing Main Story Campaign Vol. 8 \[Expedition].

IV.New system: Combat Fairy Battle

In order to help reduce Source Iron usage in Légion Étrangère for Commanders, we have added the Combat Fairy Battle next to it.

In this system, you can use a new item, Combat Fairy, to conduct instant battles. Combat Fairy can be obtained through the following methods:

1. Limited exchange with Corn in the Fairy Exchange store (resetson the 1st of each month).

2. From buying Gold during microtransaction events.

V. Microtransaction events

1. Energy Cubes from purchasing Gold

Dear Commanders    
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on May 30. The estimated update time is 8 hours.  

Update contents:
I. New metal maidens:
1. TA-2, obtainable through the Glutton on a Palm event.
2. Fay, obtainable through:
- Feeding Epsilon in the Glutton on a Palm event (very low chance).
- Exchange for Crystal Shells.
(Note: The Sky Steel system must be unlocked to obtain this Farer.)
3. Centauro 155/39 LW, obtainable through R&D.

- Exchange for Vouchers in the Mercenary section of the Museum.
- Use the Access Card gained from using the Helium Gold Bracelet to enter the special store for recruitment at a significant discount (over 50% off the original price).

II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commanders to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of Farers’ physiology and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will rate the items you feed her differently, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the final reward for this event.
This time, the reward is TA-2.
Epsilon’s maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. As a result, the difficulty of achieving the necessary satisfaction level has been drastically reduced!
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. The indigestion mechanic has been removed, so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. An auto-feeding system has been added, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.
3. There is a chance to obtain Crystal Shells each time Epsilon is fed. The probability and number of Crystal Shells obtained depend on the item that’s being used.
4. If Epsilon is fed Architecture Blueprints, aside from getting high satisfaction, she will also drop a single guaranteed piece of Incomplete Intelligence. However, you will not get any other items.
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A voyager: Fay (Requires Sky Steel system to be unlocked).
Fay can also be obtained directly from feeding Epsilon (very low chance; requires Sky Steel system to be unlocked). Please note this is an extra bonus, so we advise against trying excessively for this specific drop.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much S1 equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure that you need a large number of Crystal Shells, exchanging with vouchers bought for Gold may be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is the purchase of M-Supply.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
This special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool is an optimized version of the G-Iron Blasting Pool, with an increased drop rate for advanced equipment.
P.S. This iteration of the Intelligence Deciphering event will not feature specific milestone rewards; it serves as a dedicated channel for acquiring advanced equipment.

notes.content:
Dear Commanders 
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on 26 January. The estimated update time is 8 hours. 

Update contents:
I. New metal maidens:
1. VK 36.01, obtainable through the Glutton on a Palm event.
2. 300 Light Tank, obtainable through:
- Feeding Epsilon in the Glutton on a Palm event (very low chance).
- Exchange for Crystal Shells.
3. B1 Draco, obtainable through R&D.
4. M110A2 CBS, obtainable through purchasing the Special Elite Pack in Winter Limited Promotion. (Please note that after this update, Autumn Limited Packs will no longer be available.)

II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commander to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of how Farers' bodies work and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will rate the items you feed her differently, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon's satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the first reward for this event.
This time, the reward is VK 36.01.
Epsilon's maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. The indigestion mechanic has been removed, so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. An auto-feeding system has been added, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.
3. There is a chance to obtain Crystal Shells each time Epsilon is fed. The probability and number of items obtained depend on the item that's being used.
4. If Epsilon is fed Architecture Blueprints, aside from getting high satisfaction, she will also drop a single guaranteed piece of Incomplete Intelligence. However, you will not get any other items.
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A metal maiden: 300 Light Tank
300 Light Tank can be obtained with a very low chance directly from feeding Epsilon.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure that you need a large number of Crystal Shells, exchanging with vouchers bought for Gold may be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is the purchase of M-Supply.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
Please note that this Intelligence Deciphering event does not have a specific reward like it used to, and is now simply a way to efficiently obtain advanced equipment.
The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses Incomplete Intelligence, which can be obtained through the following methods:
1. Guaranteed obtaining when feeding Epsilon with Architecture Blueprints in the Glutton on a Palm event.
2. The exchange for Club Vouchers in the event store.
3. The exchange for Tanghulu in the event store, for a limited number of times.
4. The exchange for Crystal Shells in the event store, for a limited number of times.
5. The exchange for G-SiSe in the event store, for a limited number of times.
6. Completing a quest by passing Story Vol.8 Expedition.

1. Gold purchasing missions
Added Gold purchasing missions to Newbie missions.

notes.content:
Dear Commanders 
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on November 29. The estimated update time is 8 hours. 

Update contents:
I. New metal maidens:

II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commander to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of how Farers’ bodies work and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will rate the items you feed her differently, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the first reward for this event.
This time, the reward is Spjfm/43-44.
Epsilon’s maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. The indigestion mechanic has been removed, so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. An auto-feeding system has been added, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.
3. There is a chance to obtain Crystal Shells each time Epsilon is fed. The probability and number of items obtained depend on the item that’s being used.
4. If Epsilon is fed Architecture Blueprints, aside from getting high satisfaction, she will also drop a single guaranteed piece of Incomplete Intelligence. However, you will not get any other items.
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A metal maiden: STT Vulcan
STT Vulcan can be obtained with a very low chance directly from feeding Epsilon.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure that you need a large number of Crystal Shells, exchanging with vouchers bought for Gold may be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is the purchase of M-Supply.

notes.title: Update Announcement on September 29
notes.content:
Dear Commanders    
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on September 29. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Update contents:
I. New metal maidens:
1. T9E2 Airborne Light Tank, obtainable through the Glutton on a Palm event.
2. WZ-122-1, obtainable through:
- Feeding Epsilon in the Glutton on a Palm event (very low chance).
- Exchange for Crystal Shells.
3. AMX-10 ALLARM, obtainable through R&D.

II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commander to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of how Farers’ bodies work and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will rate the items you feed her differently, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the first reward for this event.
This time, the reward is T9E2 Airborne Light Tank.
Epsilon’s maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. The indigestion mechanic has been removed, so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. An auto-feeding system has been added, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.
3. There is a chance to obtain Crystal Shells each time Epsilon is fed. The probability and number of items obtained depend on the item that’s being used.
4. If Epsilon is fed Architecture Blueprints, aside from getting high satisfaction, she will also drop a single guaranteed piece of Incomplete Intelligence. However, you will not get any other items.
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A metal maiden: WZ-122-1
WZ-122-1 can be obtained with a very low chance directly from feeding Epsilon.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure that you need a large number of Crystal Shells, exchanging with vouchers bought for Gold may be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is the purchase of M-Supply.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
Please note that this Intelligence Deciphering event does not have a specific reward like it used to, and is now simply a way to efficiently obtain advanced equipment.

notes.content:
Dear Commanders
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:30(UTC+8) on May 30. The estimated update time is 8 hours. 

Update contents:
I. New metal maidens:
1. Strv m/41 TD, obtainable through the 'Glutton on a Palm' event.
1. KPz T III, obtainable through:
- Feeding Epsilon in the 'Glutton on a Palm' event (very low chance).
- Exchange for 'Crystal Shells'.
3. Leopard 1T 'Volkan', obtainable through:
- Using the 'Helium Gold Bracelet' from the 'Super Special Package'.
- Exchange for 'Vouchers' in the 'Mercenary' section of the Museum.
4. AMX-32, obtainable through R&D (air maiden system needs to be unlocked first).

II. New stages: Shortcut Battle
Originally, commanders would have to play 5 nodes in stage 4 of each Campaign volume.
In order to improve the grinding experience, we have added new stages, called the Shortcut Battle.
Drops in the Shortcut Battle will be equal to stage 4 of the corresponding Campaign volume.
You will only have to play 1 stage in the Shortcut Battle to receive the same rewards as from the 5 nodes of the normal Campaign stage, and resources equivalent to those needed to clear 5 nodes will be consumed.
The difficulty will be equal to the final boss node of stage 4 of each Campaign volume.
In order to play the Shortcut Battle, aside from having to meet Commander Level and HQ level requirements, you also need to achieve an S rank in 2 volumes ahead in the Campaign (for example, to play the Shortcut Battle for volume 1, you need to achieve an S rank in Campaign volume 3).
The new stages also support the Auto Fighter function, which we hope will help improve the grinding experience for commanders.

II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commander to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of how Farers' bodies work and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will rate the items you feed her differently, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon's satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the first reward for this event.
This time, the reward is Strv m/41 TD.
Epsilon's maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. The indigestion mechanic has been removed, so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. An auto-feeding system has been added, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.
3. There is a chance to obtain 'Crystal Shells' each time Epsilon is fed. The probability and number of items obtained depend on the item that's being used.
4. If Epsilon is fed 'Architecture Blueprints', aside from getting high satisfaction, she will also drop a single guaranteed piece of 'Incomplete Intelligence'. However, you will not get any other items.
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A metal maiden: KPz T III
KPz T III can be obtained with a very low chance directly from feeding Epsilon.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure that you need a large number of 'Crystal Shells', exchanging with vouchers bought for Gold may be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is the purchase of M-Supply.

IV. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
Please note that this Intelligence Deciphering event does not have a specific reward like it used to, and is now simply a way to efficiently obtain advanced equipment.
The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses 'Incomplete Intelligence', which can be obtained through the following methods:
1. Guaranteed obtaining when feeding Epsilon with 'Architecture Blueprints' in the Glutton on a Palm event.
2. The exchange for 'Club Vouchers' in the event store.
3. The exchange for 'Tanghulu' in the event store, for a limited number of times.
4. The exchange for 'Crystal Shells' in the event store, for a limited number of times.
5. The exchange for 'G-SiSe' in the event store, for a limited number of times.

As Leopard 1T 'Volkan' is added in this update, we have made some adjustments to the Super Special Offer.
Previously, using the Helium Gold Bracelet would grant you: Tiger Ausf. B (10.5 cm), Access Card x1, Fate Pins x10, Loyalty Coins x167, Reserve Corps Emblems x144, and Recruit Bags x10.

notes.title: Update announcement on July 28
notes.content:

We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on July 28. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

I. New metal maidens:
1. Krupp-Ardelt WT, obtainable through the 'Glutton on a Palm' event.

- Very low chance to obtain from feeding Epsilon in the 'Glutton on a Palm'.
- Exchange for 'Crystal Shells'.
3. Panzer III/IV (X-7 ATGM), obtainable through R&D (this metal maiden has a special R&D method which uses 'Origin Stones' obtained from Petrov Warrant's rewards).
4. Panhard EBR, obtainable through buying the Special Elite package in summer-limited promotion.

II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commander to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of how Farers' bodies work and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will give different ratings to the items you feed her, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon's satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the first reward for this event.
This time, the reward is a metal maiden: Krupp-Ardelt WT.
Epsilon's maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. Removed the indigestion system so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. Added an auto-feeding system, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go. You can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feeding will continue until the item runs out.
3. When feeding, there is a chance to obtain 'Crystal Shells'. The probability and number of items obtained depend on the item that's being used.
4. If Epsilon is fed with 'Architecture Blueprints', aside from getting high satisfaction, you will also be guaranteed to obtain a single piece of 'Incomplete Intelligence'. However, you will not get any other items.
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A metal maiden: Ro'em (ML-20)
Ro'em (ML-20) can be obtained with a very low chance directly from feeding Epsilon.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure that you need a large number of 'Crystal Shells', exchanging with vouchers bought for Gold may be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is the purchase of the M-Supply.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
Please note that this Intelligence Deciphering event does not have a specific reward like it used to, and is now simply a way to efficiently obtain advanced equipment.
The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses 'Incomplete Intelligence', which can be obtained through the following methods:
1. Guaranteed obtaining when feeding Epsilon with 'Architecture Blueprints' in the Glutton on a Palm event.
2. The exchange for 'Club Certificate' in the event store.
3. The exchange for 'Tanghulu' in the event store, for a limited number of times.
4. The exchange for 'Crystal Shell' in the event store, for a limited number of times.
5. The exchange for 'G-SiSe' in the event store, for a limited number of times.

During the event period, purchasing gold will grant 'Golden Corals'.

Purchasing a Big Bag of Gold grants 2 'Golden Corals'.

notes.title: March 24 update announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:30(UTC+8) on March 24. The estimated update time is 8 hours 

The contents of the update are as following:
I. New metal maidens:
1. M41/60E, obtainable through the 'Glutton on a Palm' event.
2. FV4202, obtainable through the following methods:
- Very low chance to obtain from feeding Epsilon in 'Glutton on a Palm'.
- Exchange for 'Crystal Shells'.
3. KV-4 (Mikhailov), obtainable through R&D (this metal maiden has a special R&D method which uses 'Origin Stones' obtained from Petrov Warrant's rewards).


II. Glutton on a Palm event
Portia has asked Commander to collect various equipment (normal S1 and S2, advanced S1, as well as N2 to N4 blueprints) and certain collectibles for feeding to Epsilon in order to gain a deeper understanding of how Farers' bodies work and to refine her existing databases.
Epsilon will give different ratings to the items you feed her, and you will receive corresponding rewards.
After each feeding, Epsilon's satisfaction level will increase depending on how much she liked the item she ate.
Once the satisfaction level has hit a certain threshold, you can collect the first reward for this event.
This time, the reward is a metal maiden, M41/60E.
Epsilon's maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. Removed the indigestion system so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. Added an auto-feeding system, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in one go (you can still use this system even if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feed will feed until the item runs out).
3. When feeding, there is a chance to obtain 'Crystal Shells' (probability and amount dependent on the item used).
4. If Epsilon is fed with 'Architecture Blueprints', aside from getting high satisfaction, you will also be guaranteed to obtain a single piece of 'Incomplete Intelligence' (however, you will not get any other items).
Tap on the Crystal Shells in the Depot to open the Exchange Shop, which contains the following:
1. Limited edition badges and wallpapers from previous events
2. Limited edition resource packs
3. A metal maiden: FV4202
FV4202 has a very low chance to be obtained directly from feeding Epsilon.
Crystal Shells can be bought for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure you need a large number of 'Crystal Shells', exchanging with vouchers bought with Gold will be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is buying the M-Supply.


III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
Please note that this Intelligence Deciphering event does not have a specific reward like it used to, and is now simply a way to efficiently obtain advanced equipment.
The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses 'Incomplete Intelligence', which can be obtained through the following methods:
1. Guaranteed obtaining when feeding Epsilon with 'Architecture Blueprints' in the Glutton on a Palm.
2. Exchanged for 'Club Certificate' in the event store.
3. Exchanged for 'Tanghulu' in the event store (for a limited number of times).
4. Exchanged for 'Crystal Shell' in the event store (for a limited number of times).
5. Exchanged for 'G-SiSe' in the event store (for a limited number of times).
6. A certain amount can be received from a quest after passing Story Vol.8 'Expedition'.


IV. Microtransaction events
1. Confidential Files and Golden Corals from purchasing Gold
During the event period, purchasing gold will grant 'Confidential Files' and 'Golden Corals'.
Purchasing a Small Bag of Gold grants 6 'Confidential Files' and 1 'Golden Coral'.
Purchasing a Big Bag of Gold grants 12 'Confidential Files' and 2 'Golden Corals'.
Purchasing a Small Box of Gold grants 32 'Confidential Files' and 5 'Golden Corals'.
Purchasing a Big Box of Gold grants 64 'Confidential Files' and 10 'Golden Corals'.
In the Depot, tap on the 'Confidential Files' or the 'Gold Corals' to exchange them for desired materials in the corresponding shops.
Golden Corals can be exchanged for most wallpapers and badges from previous events.

2. Club Vouchers from purchasing Gold
During the event, purchasing gold will grant you a certain number of 'Club Vouchers'.
Purchasing a Small Bag of Gold grants 690 'Club Vouchers'.
Purchasing a Big Bag of Gold grants 1290 'Club Vouchers'.
Purchasing a Small Box of Gold grants 3270 'Club Vouchers'.
Purchasing a Big Box of Gold grants 6480 'Club Vouchers'.

'Club Vouchers' can be used for a limited number of times to purchase vouchers in the Limited Material Sale.

3. Double Petrov Warrant

Purchasing a Big Bag of Gold grants 2 Petrov Warrants.
Purchasing a Small Box of Gold grants 4 Petrov Warrants.
Purchasing a Big Box of Gold grants 6 Petrov Warrants.

notes.title: November 1st Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders 
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 13:30(UTC+8) on November 1. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Update details are as follows:

I. New tanks
1. LVT(A)-4 (37mm), obtainable through the following methods:

- Research through an event-exclusive special R&D path. The 'T99 Type M Lollipop' needed for R&D will be purchasable from the material shop in the resource purchase section.
Please note that this metal maiden will be made available once the Military Forge event begins.

II. Targeted Forge Event
During the event period, there will be two forge events for the following tanks:
1. LVT(A)-4 (37mm)
2. WZ-211
Both are obtainable through the forge event or can be exchanged with corresponding event items.

LVT(A)-4 (37mm)'s event item is 'Blue Ribbon' and the event item for WZ-211 is 'Bamboo Scroll', both obtainable through the forge event.
During the event period, each 'Waterproof Leg Bag' can be exchanged for a 'Blue Ribbon' for a limited number of times.
Commanders who have the 'Petrov Warrant' active can obtain a number of 'Blue Ribbons' by pressing the Time-limited Award button in the Award section of 'Hunting Missions'.
The two event items can also be exchanged for the following rewards:

450x of each: Wreck, Secret Plan, Processor, Test Doll
36,000x Codon
210x Second-hand Material
10x Occult Jellyfish

III. Military Forge Event
In order to help new commanders progress quicker, we have modified the bi-monthly Targeted Forge event into a permanent iron forge event.
(Please note that this event will open in 3 to 4 days after the Targeted Forge event ends.)
After this event starts, the event entrance button will appear in the store section (the same section where G-Iron Forge entrance is located, and will be unlocked after clearing Story Volume 1 Part 4). This event is permanent and will stay open indefinitely after starting. After you have claimed all rewards (3 metal maidens in Elite Team, M26 Pershing (T99), and other rewards exchangeable with 'Commemorative Silver Coin' and Lollipop'), the event entrance button will be automatically hidden.

Purchasable in the SF22 Store.

Purchasable in the SF22 Store.

notes.title: How to restore the simplified Chinese version
notes.content:
Dear Commanders
If you can't display Simplified Chinese in the game for some reason, please try the following operations to recover

1. First, after exiting the game completely, delete the game's local save file UserDefault.xml
The archive file path is generally under C:\Users\ (your current Windows account)\AppData\Local\Sherman

2. Then select Simplified Chinese in the steam client
The selection method is:
right click game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28447584/c5a8d08d79c10700c37137f43790f6d4bb74c122.png
select properties

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28447584/b13a38fb0d6bc2c766cc637b2a29ea20c0fc9ad3.png

We are still in the process of related optimization, please pay close attention.

notes.title: Update announcement on September 30
notes.content:
Dear Commanders 
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on September 30. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Details of the update are as follows:

I. New tanks
1. Lorraine 40t, obtainable through 'Glutton on a Palm'.
2. Holt 150 t, obtainable through the following methods:
- Very low chance to obtain from feeding Epsilon in 'Glutton on a Palm'.
- Exchange for 'Crystal Shells'.
3. Sav 20.12.48, obtainable from buying a special pack in the Fall Limited-time Store, her appearance and stats can be seen in the SForce section of R&D.
4. Object 432, obtainable through R&D (this metal maiden has a special R&D method which uses 'Origin Stones' obtained from Petrov Warrant's rewards).

II. Glutton on a Palm: 'Epsilon never acts up' edition!
In order to conduct further study about the Farers, Portia has ordered Commander to gather equipment (S1, S2, S1A, N2-4 Blueprints) and collectibles (Bow Tie, Machine Snake Eye, Bedroom Key) to feed to Epsilon.
Epsilon will evaluate the food and Commander will be rewarded accordingly.
After each feeding, Epsilon's satisfaction will increase based on the food's taste (the more she likes the food, the more points gained).
When her satisfaction reaches its maximum, you will receive the first big reward of the event (this time it's Lorraine 40t).
Epsilon's maximum satisfaction will remain at 1,000, but she will no longer suffer from indigestion. We hope this change will significantly alleviate the difficulty of the event.
All of the changes made to the event are as follows:
1. Removed the indigestion system so Epsilon can be fed continuously.
2. Added an auto-feeding system, which allows Epsilon to be fed 50 times in a row (if the number of equipment or collectibles being used for feeding is lower than 50, the auto-feed will end when the item runs out).
3. When feeding, there is a chance to obtain 'Crystal Shell' (probability and amount dependent on the item used).
4. If Epsilon is fed with 'Architecture Blueprints', aside from getting high satisfaction, you will also be guaranteed to obtain a single 'Incomplete Intelligence' (however, you will not get any other items).
Tap on the 'Crystal Shell' in the Depot to open its exchange store which offers the following items:
1. Badges and backgrounds from past events.
2. New background: Sunflower Plains
3. Time-limited resource packages.
4. Metal maiden: Holt 150 t
Holt 150 t has a very low chance to be obtained directly from feeding Epsilon.
'Crystal Shell' can be exchanged for vouchers in the event store.
Please note that we recommend newbie commanders to refrain from feeding too much equipment to Epsilon as that might have an adverse effect on their progression. If you are completely sure you need a large number of 'Crystal Shells', exchanging with vouchers bought with Gold will be a better method. The most efficient way of gaining Gold is buying the M-Supply.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special blasting pool of Intelligence Deciphering has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
Please note that this Intelligence Deciphering event does not have a specific reward like it used to, and is now simply a way to efficiently obtain advanced equipment.
The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses 'Incomplete Intelligence', which can be obtained through the following methods:
1. Guaranteed obtaining when feeding Epsilon with 'Architecture Blueprints' in the Glutton on a Palm.
2. Exchanged for 'Club Certificate' in the event store.
3. Exchanged for 'Tanghulu' in the event store (for a limited number of times).
4. Exchanged for 'Crystal Shell' in the event store (for a limited number of times).
5. Exchanged for 'G-SiSe' in the event store (for a limited number of times).
6. A certain amount can be received from a quest after passing Story Vol.8 'Expedition'.

IV. Additional rewards for purchasing Gold
During the event period, purchasing Gold will grant you a certain number of 'Confidential Files'.
Purchasing 'Small Bag of Gold' grants 6 'Confidential Files' and 690 'Club Certificates'.
Purchasing 'Big Bag of Gold' grants 12 'Confidential Files' and 1290  'Club Certificates'.
Purchasing 'Small Box of Gold' grants 32 'Confidential Files' and 3270 'Club Certificates'.
Purchasing 'Big Box of Gold' grants 64 'Confidential Files' and 6480 'Club Certificates'.
Tap on 'Confidential Files' in the Depot to go to the Underground Bazaar and purchase various resources.
Tap on 'Club Certificates' to open their exchange store which offers the following items:
A. Badges and backgrounds from past events.
B. New background: Rhine Valley Base.
C. Time-limited resources packages.
D. New commander portrait: Dwight.
'Club Certificate' can also be exchanged for vouchers in the event store.

2. During the event period, you will receive double the amount of 'Petrov Warrants' from purchasing gold.
Purchasing 'Small Bag of Gold' grants 2 'Petrov Warrants'
Purchasing 'Big Bag of Gold' grants 2 'Petrov Warrants'
Purchasing 'Small Box of Gold' grants 4 'Petrov Warrants'
Purchasing 'Big Box of Gold' grants 6 'Petrov Warrants'

V. New rewards in 'Hunting Mission'
Added a new item, 'Origin Stone', to the rewards from activating the 'Petrov Warrant' (rewards that were originally in the slots now occupied by Origin Stones will be evenly distributed to the same rewards in other slots).
'Origin Stone' can be used in place of resources in a special R&D method for certain metal maidens.

VI. UI adjustment
As there currently are a large number of event items and collectibles in the game, which are categorized as 'Resources' which negatively impact the convenience of using items in the Depot, the UI of the Depot has been adjusted and a new category 'Event Items' has been added, containing all past event items, which will make finding items to use in the Depot easier.

VII. Bonus Fate Pin from purchasing M-Supply
During the event period, you will receive a Fate Pin for every M-Supply purchase.

VIII. Special packages
A wide variety of packages to be browsed at your leisure. There's always something for you.
Special recruitment will also be available in this update, with newly added metal maidens.

IX. Fall time-limited sales
Quarterly time-limited sales have been slightly adjusted. After this update, the sales opening time will not be dependent on other events and entrance to the shop will appear in the time-limited event section directly. (Please note that after this update, the summer time-limited packages that have not yet been bought will be unpurchasable.)

X. New skins and backgrounds.
1. New skin: Sweet as Sugar (BTR-60-100)
Can be exchanged for vouchers in the SF22 store.
2. New background: Sunflower Plains
Can be exchanged for 'Crystal Shell'.
3. New background: Rhine Valley base
Can be exchanged for 'Club Certificate'.

XI. Additional rewards from iron forge and aluminum forge
During the event period, using the iron forge will guarantee you 'Prion Fossils' which can be exchanged for a random number of Wrecks, Secret Plans, Processors, Test Dolls, or Codon in the Fossil Exchange section of the Exchange shop. Using the aluminum forge will also guarantee you a random amount of Rainbow Oxamide.

XII. Data adjustment
1. TV-8: Increased armor.
2. Stingray Light Tank: Increased penetration.
3. T-62: Increased firepower, penetration, durability and armor.
4. ASU-57 (OKB-115): Increased firepower.
5. Akv 151: Increased penetration and armor.
6. Hummel (Late): Increased evasion.

XIII. Attire names adjustment
Several attire names have been adjusted for accuracy.

notes.title: September 2 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on September 2. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Update details are as follows:

I. New tanks
1. Makmat 160mm, obtainable through the following methods:
- Direct Obtaining from Iron Forge.
- Exchange for'Waterproof Leg Bag' obtained from Iron Forge.
2. TH-400, obtainable through the following methods:
- Direct Obtaining from Iron Forge.
- Exchange for'Alloy Flask' obtained from Iron Forge.
- Exchange for vouchers.
3. Ju 288 (N5 Attack Aircraft), obtainable through R&D.

II. Iron Forge Event
During the event period, there will be two forge events for the following tanks:
1. Makmat 160mm
2. TH-400
Both are obtainable through the forge event or can be exchanged with corresponding event items.
TH-400 can also be bought from the event store using vouchers.
Makmat 160mm’s event item is'Waterproof Leg Bag' and the event item for TH-400 is'Alloy Flask', both obtainable through the forge event.
During the event period, each'Mortar Shell' can be exchanged for a'Waterproof Leg Bag' for a limited number of times.
Commanders who have the'Petrov Warrant' active can obtain a number of'Waterproof Leg Bags' by pressing the Time-limited Award button in the Award section of'Hunting Missions'.
The two event items can also be exchanged for the following rewards:
Waterproof Leg Bag: 1x Marching Rucksack (Limited to 1 time)
Alloy Flask: 1x Fate Pin (Limited to 1 time)
A Marching Rucksack contains:
2x Fate Pin
450x of each: Wreck, Secret Plan, Processor, Test Doll
36 000x Codon
210x Second-hand Material
10x Occult Jellyfish

III. Reintroduction of classic skins
As there are a considerable number of skins in the game now, we will adjust the skin obtaining method to allow commanders to obtain skins more easily.
However, a direct reduction in skin prices would be unfair to commanders who have previously bought skins, so we will use a different method to ensure that the value of existing skins is not diminished.
Skins that are added after this update will be categorized into the'SF22' store and skins previously released will be categorized into the'Classic' store.
Skins in the'SF22' store will be cheaper than those in the'Classic' store, and the prices of skins in the'Classic' store will remain the same.
The important aspect of this adjustment is, after granting a metal maiden with a skin from the'Classic' store, you will receive'Skin Rebate Coins' and'Loyalty Coins' from the mission section, the amounts of which correspond to the price of the bought skin.
Skin Rebate Coins' can be used to buy skins in the'SF22' store.
Loyalty Coins' can be used in the Depot to exchange for various materials (Iron, Corn, Rainbow Oxamide). Think of it as a hard currency.
An example of how this works:
After buying the'Banquet Dress' skin from the'Classic' store (for 295 vouchers) and granting it to the metal maiden who owns it, you will receive 219'Skin Rebate Coins' and 73'Loyalty Coins'.
Then you can go to the'SF22' store to buy the new'Raw Milk Fine Wine' skin.
The original price of the'Raw Milk Fine Wine' skin is 120 vouchers, but if you use the'Skin Rebate Coins' to buy, you would need to only pay 100'Skin Rebate Coins' and 20 vouchers. (You will also receive'Loyalty Coins' for buying skins with'Skin Rebate Coins' too.)
In summary, commanders who have previously granted classic skins to metal maidens will be able to buy new skins in the'SF22' store for only 20 vouchers and will also receive additional'Loyalty Coins'.
So, we recommend commanders who have previously granted classic skins to metal maidens to claim rewards from the mission section before buying skins in the'SF22' store.
For commanders who have never bought any classic skin, you can use vouchers to buy skins in the'SF22' store immediately, or you can buy a classic skin from the'Classic' store and grant it to the metal maiden, and then use the rewards gained to buy skins in the'SF22' store.
Tip: You have to buy a skin box and use it in the Depot before awarding it to the metal maiden (the metal maiden must be promoted to 3 stars and awarded a Fate Pin to be able to use a skin).

IV. Additional rewards for purchasing Gold
During the event period, purchasing Gold will grant you a certain number of'Confidential Files'.
Purchasing'Small Bag of Gold' grants 6'Confidential Files'
Purchasing'Big Bag of Gold' grants 12'Confidential Files'
Purchasing'Small Box of Gold' grants 32'Confidential Files'
Purchasing'Big Box of Gold' grants 64'Confidential Files'
Tap on'Confidential Files' in the Depot to go to the Underground Bazaar and purchase various resources.

V. The double gold bonus for the first purchase has been reset.

VI. Extra reward from M-Supply purchase
During the event, purchasing M-Supply will grant you a'Supply Document Bag'.
Use the'Supply Document Bag' to exchange for a Fate Pin or a'Recruit Bag'.
Use the'Recruit Bag' to get the following resources:
Wrecks x90
Secret Plans x90
Processors x90
Test Dolls x90
Codon x20,000
Engineering Fairy x1,500

VII. Special packages
A wide variety of packages to be browsed at your leisure. There’s always something for you.
Special Recruitment will also be available in this update.

VIII. New skin and backgrounds
As there are already a considerable number of skins in the game, skin acquisition will now be centralized into the'Skin Store' in the Store section.
1. New skin: Raw Milk Fine Wine (WZ-111 Heavy Tank)
Can be exchanged with vouchers in the'SF22' store.
2. New backgrounds: Jungle Ruins and Northland Village
These two backgrounds are time-limited and can be purchased in the backgrounds store during the event period.

IX. Additional rewards from iron forge and aluminum forge
During the event period, each use of the iron forge will guarantee you a'Prion Fossil' which can be exchanged for a random number of Wrecks, Secret Plans, Processors, Test Dolls, or Codon in the Fossil Exchange section of the Exchange store. Using the aluminum forge will also guarantee you a random amount of Rainbow Oxamide.

X. Data adjustment
1. AMX-13/SM1: Increased firepower growth and stealth.
2. AMX-50: Increased firepower growth and penetration growth.
3. TB-3: Increased durability growth and armor.
4. M43 SPG: Attire name changed to T84 HMC. Granted one Turret equipment slot. Increased targeting.
5. IS-2m: Attire name changed to IS-2M

XI. Attire names adjustment
Several attire names have been adjusted for accuracy.

notes.title: August 5th Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders      
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 11:00(UTC+8) on August 5. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Update details are as follows:

I. New tanks
1. LT-432, obtainable through the following methods:
- Direct obtaining from [Blueprint Analysis].
- Exchange for [Beacon Necklaces] obtained from [Blueprint Analysis].
- Exchange for vouchers.
2. T114 BAT, obtainable through the following methods:
- Exchange for [Beacon Necklace] obtained from [Blueprint Analysis].
- Exchange for vouchers.
- Low chance to obtain from Iron Blasting.
3. AML-60, obtainable through R&D.
4. ASU-57 (OKB-115), obtainable through [Palm Diner].

II. Palm Diner Event
In order to conduct further study about the Farers, Portia has ordered Commander to gather equipment (S1, S2, S1A, N2-4 Blueprints) and collectibles (Bow Tie, Machine Snake Eye, Bedroom Key) to feed to Epsilon.
Epsilon will evaluate the food and Commander will be rewarded accordingly.
After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction will increase based on the food’s taste (the more she likes the food, the more points gained).
When her satisfaction reaches its maximum, you will receive the first big reward of the event (this time it’s ASU-57 (OKB-115)).
*Please note that if Epsilon is overfed (especially with high-rarity equipment), she might suffer indigestion, preventing you from feeding her further for a while (but you can give her a [Tanghulu] to help with that.)
During the event period, you can randomly get [Tanghulus] from Iron Blasting, and they can also be bought for gold directly from the event store.
If Epsilon is most satisfied with the food, you will also get [Luxury Avatar Coupons], which can be used to exchange for various skins from the museum, and during the Palm Diner event, you can also randomly get [Luxury Avatar Coupons] from Iron Blasting.
Aside from the aforementioned rewards, if Epsilon is mildly or most satisfied, you will get 1 or 3 Architecture Blueprints respectively, which can be used in the Blueprint Analysis event.

III. Blueprint Analysis Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Blueprint Analysis event, which will need [Architecture Blueprints] to use. Details of this special blasting pool are as follows: 
1. Rewards from the Blueprint Analysis blasting pool will be based on the normal Iron Blasting pool.
2. Blueprint Analysis has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment than Iron Blasting.
3. In addition to the base rewards, there is a chance to obtain an extra reward: Engineering Fairies, Auto-fighter or three types of resource production boost buff items (these rewards are a separate drop and will not replace the base rewards).
4. There is a 40% chance to obtain the [Beacon Necklace] event item which can be exchanged for LT-432 and T114 BAT.
5. There is a chance to directly obtain LT-432.
[Architecture Blueprints] can be obtained through the following methods:
1. By purchasing gold during the event:
20 from buying a Small Bag of Gold;
40 from buying a Big Bag of Gold;
120 from buying a Small Box of Gold;
280 from buying a Big Box of Gold.
3. A certain amount can be obtained from a quest after passing Story Vol.8 [Expedition].
4. By exchanging with [Bedroom Key] in the event store (for a limited number of times).

IV. Perseverance Coin Event in Clash
The event details are as follows:
1. During the event, when you attack in Clash, you will get 5 Perseverance Coins no matter the results.
2. If you search and defeat an opponent whose medal count is higher than 6 000, you will receive 10 more Perseverance Coins (for a total of 15).
If you defeat an opponent whose medal count is over 9 000, you will receive 20 more Perseverance Coins (for a total of 25).
3. Winning in retaliation battles and defensive battles won’t award Perseverance Coins. Only battles that use Diesel count.
4. Perseverance Coins can be used by tapping at them in the Depot, which will open the exchange store which offer the following rewards:

notes.title: June 9 Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders     
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 13:30(UTC+8) on June 9. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Details of the update are as follows:

I. New tanks
1. BMR-600
2. Akv 151
3. Panter III L-21/E-3
4. PASI XA-180 (This metal maiden is a reward from the summer time-limited package, her initial details are available in the Sforce section.)

II. Palm Diner Event
In order to conduct further study about the Farers, Portia has ordered Commander to gather equipment (S1, S2, S1A, N2-4 Blueprints) and collectibles (Bow Tie, Machine Snake Eye, Bedroom Key) to feed to Epsilon.
Epsilon will evaluate the food and Commander will be rewarded accordingly.
After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction will increase based on the food’s taste (the more she likes the food, the more points gained).
When her satisfaction reaches its maximum, you will receive the first big reward of the event (this time it’s BMR-600).
*Please note that if Epsilon is overfed (especially with high-rarity equipment), she might suffer indigestion, preventing you from feeding her further for a while (but you can give her a “Tanghulu” to help with that.)

If Epsilon is most satisfied with the food, you will also get “Luxury Avatar Coupons”, which can be used to exchange for various skins from the museum, and during the Palm Diner event, you can also randomly get “Luxury Avatar Coupons” from Iron Blasting.

During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.

20 from buying a Small Bag of Gold;
40 from buying a Big Bag of Gold;
80 from buying a Small Box of Gold;
160 from buying a Big Box of Gold.
3. A certain amount can be received from a quest after passing Story Vol.8 “Expedition”.

Purchasing “Big Bag of Gold” grants 12 “Confidential Files”
Purchasing “Small Box of Gold” grants 32 “Confidential Files”
Purchasing “Big Box of Gold” grants 64 “Confidential Files”
Tap on “Confidential File” in the Depot to go to the Underground Bazaar and purchase various resources.

After each time-limited event (e.g. Palm Diner, Forge, etc. except Museum and limited packages) has ended, an entry to summer time-limited store will appear in the time-limited event tab.
Commanders can enter the store and buy summer time-limited packages. (Please note that after this update, the spring time-limited packages that have not yet been bought will be unpurchasable.)

notes.title: November 17 update announcement
notes.content:
Dear Commanders    
We plan to perform a patch update on the server at 10:30(UTC+8) on November 17. The estimated update time is 8 hours.

Details of the update are as follows:

I. New tanks
1. KV-4 (Fedorenko)
2. M113 FSCV
3. Bat.-Châtillon 155
4. P-47 Thunderbolt

II. Palm Diner Event
To further study about the Farers, Portia has ordered the Commander to gather equipment (S1, S2, S1A, N2-4 Blueprints) and collectibles (Bow Tie, Machine Snake Eye, Bedroom Key) to feed Epsilon.
Epsilon will evaluate the food and the Commander will be rewarded accordingly.
After each feeding, Epsilon’s satisfaction will increase based on the food’s taste (the more she likes the food, the more points gained).
When her satisfaction reaches its maximum, you will receive the first big reward of the event (this time it’s the M113 FSCV).
*Please note that if Epsilon is overfed (especially with high-rarity equipment), she might suffer indigestion, preventing you from feeding her further for a while (but you can give her a “Tanghulu” to help with that.)
During the event period, you can randomly get “Tanghulu” from Iron Blasting, and it can also be bought directly from the event store.
If Epsilon is most satisfied with the food, you will also get “Luxury Avatar Coupons”, which can be used to exchange for various skins from the museum, and during the Palm Diner event, you can also randomly get “Luxury Avatar Coupons” from Iron Blasting.

III. Intelligence Deciphering Event
During the event, a special blasting pool will be available for the Intelligence Deciphering event.
The special blasting pool of Intelligence Deciphering has a higher chance to drop advanced equipment.
You have a chance to receive a “Spherical Circuit” from Intelligence Deciphering, which can be used in the Depot to redeem one of the following rewards:
1. Bat.-Châtillon 155 (Metal Maiden)
2. A Maiden’s Longing Skin Box (Skin for Type 59-1 Autocannon)
You can receive the “Spherical Circuit” ONLY ONCE, so please choose your reward wisely.
Bat.-Châtillon 155 and A Maiden’s Longing Skin Box can also be bought with vouchers.
The Intelligence Deciphering blasting pool uses “Incomplete Intelligence”, which can be earned through the following methods:
1. When feeding Epsilon in the Palm Diner event. If she is mildly satisfied or most satisfied, you will get 1 or 3 Incomplete Intelligence respectively.
2. Buying gold during the event;
20 from buying a Small Bag of Gold
40 from buying a Big Bag of Gold
80 from buying a Small Box of Gold
160 from buying a Big Box of Gold
3. A certain amount from a quest after passing Story Vol.8 “Expedition”
4. Exchanged with “G-SiSe” in the event store (limited number of times)

IV. Special packages
A wide variety of packages to be browsed at your leisure. There’s always something for you.
P.S. In the update, we have reset the limit of buying equipment with corn and gold in the store.

V. New Avatar
1. A Maiden’s Longing (Type 59-1 Autocannon)
Obtainable by using “Spherical Circuit” in the Depot or buying with vouchers.

VI. Additional rewards from iron forge and aluminum forge
During the event period, using the iron forge will guarantee you a “Prion Fossil” which can be exchanged for a random number of Wrecks, Secret Plans, Processors, Test Dolls or Codon in the Fossil Exchange section of the Exchange shop. Using the aluminum forge will also guarantee you a random amount of Rainbow Oxamide.

VII. Data adjustment
1. To improve the experience and ease the R&D difficulty of new metal maidens for new players, we will temporarily make metal maidens who use the same character art as other maidens, character art with swapped heads, or no character art, unobtainable through any means.

Valentine
BT-4
T-37A
T-38
T24 Prototype

Panzer 38(t) Ausf.A

2) Panther Ausf.A: Rarity changed to Gold N3. Increased durability, armor, evasion, and detection. Granted one Special equipment slot.
3) VK.3002 (M): Rarity changed to Purple N2. Increased evasion, firepower, durability, armor, and stealth. Granted one Special equipment slot.
4) Panzer III Ausf.H: Name changed to Pz.Bef.Wg. III Ausf. H. Rarity changed to Gold N3. Increased detection, evasion, armor, and durability. Decreased targeting, firepower, and penetration.

notes.title: Update am 11. September
notes.content:
Lieber Kommandant： 
Der Server wird am 11. September um 7：30 Uhr （UTC + 2） zur Aktualisierung ausgeschaltet. Es dauert ungefähr 4 Stunden.


Um Ihnen für Ihre langjährige Unterstützung zu danken, geben wir jedem Spieler nach Abschluss der Aktualisierung 5.000 Codons (diese Codons werden zusammen mit den aktualisierten und gepflegten Kompensationsgoldmünzen verschickt, und Sie müssen sie innerhalb von 72 Stunden nach der Aktualisierung erhalten.
Der aktualisierte Inhalt ist:


I. Neu hinzugefügte Metall-Mädchen
1. MBT-70
2. T-103(dieses Metall-Mädchen ist eine Belohnung für die neu hinzugekommene Dofleini-Strategie-Mission)
3. 2S1Gvozdika(dieses Metall-Mädchen ist eine Belohnung für die zeitlich begrenzte Aktivität: Richtungsstrahlen)


II. Hinzugefügte neue Dofleini-Strategie-Mission.
Die Such- und Rettungsmission T-103 wurde zur Dofleini-Strategie hinzugefügt.
Kommandanten können einen neuen Satz von Spektralkoordinaten sammeln, um den Ort der letzten Instanz zu öffnen. Indem Sie den Energiespalt der letzten Instanz auf Null reduzieren, können Sie die Such- und Rettungsaktion abschließen und T-103 bekommen.
Im Vergleich mit der vorherigen Such- und Rettungsmission hat diese neue Mission einige Änderungen ausgeführt.
1. Es gibt keine Begrenzung der Zeiten für Überreichweitenschläge in der Such- und Rettungsaktion T-103, und der Energiespalt kann auf Null reduziert werden, indem der Überreichweitenschlag kontinuierlich durchgeführt wird.


III. Direktionale Strahlenaktivität
Beschreibung der Aktivitäten:
Während der Veranstaltungsdauer werden wir zwei exklusive Richtstrahlbecken eröffnen, die jeweils zu den folgenden gehören:
1. militärischer Rucksack (Sie können ihn benutzen, um: Schicksalsmedaille x 2, Trümmer des Chariots x 450, Geheimplan x 450, Rechenmodul x 450, Experimentalpuppe x 450, Codon x 36.000, Ingenieurwesen-Elfe x 400, gebrauchtes fliegerisches Material x 210, mysteriöse Qualle x 10 zu erhalten)
2.2S1Gvozdika (Neues Metall-Mädchen)
Sie können mit einer Wahrscheinlichkeit durch Richtstrahlen aus entsprechenden exklusiven Strahlbecken erhalten oder durch Sammeln entsprechender Aktivitätsrequisiten ausgetauscht werden. 2S1 Gvozdika kann im aktiven Tauschgeschäft gegen Gutscheine eingetauscht werden.
Militärrucksack entsprechende Requisite: Nylon-Leinwand
2S1Gvozdika entsprechende Requisite: Gvozdika Kopfschmuck
Die beiden Requisiten können mit einer Wahrscheinlichkeit aus dem entsprechenden exklusiven Strahlenbecken bezogen werden.
Während der Veranstaltung können Sie mit[Skelettmatrix-Limulus] auch[Nylon-Leinwand] im Aktivitätstauschgeschäft (mit begrenzten Zeiten) austauschen.
Der Kommandant, der die Petrov-Konzession geöffnet hat, kann auch auf die Taste[Zeitgrenze-Belohnung] auf der Belohnungsschnittstelle der Jagdmissionen klicken, um etwas[Nylon-Leinwand] zu erhalten.
Während der Veranstaltungsdauer können Sie 20 Gvozdika-Kopfbedeckungen konsumieren, um sie gegen 1 Schicksalsmedaille einzutauschen (limitiert auf 1 Zeit).


IV. Strahlenaktivität
Innerhalb einer begrenzten Zeit, Elementium Eisenstrahlen und Richtungsstrahlen: es besteht eine 100 %ige Wahrscheinlichkeit, zufällige Mengen an Belohnung in Ihren Marschrucksack zu bekommen, einschließlich Wrackteile, Geheimplanung, Kalkülmodule, experimentelle Puppen (jede Strahlung kann nur zufällig eine Art der vier Arten von Verbrauchsmaterial erhalten).
Innerhalb eines begrenzten Zeitraums haben Elementium Aluminiumstrahlen eine 100%ige Wahrscheinlichkeit, eine beliebige Regenbogen-Aminosäure zu erhalten.


V.Mehrere Arten von limitierten Sonder-Geschenkverpackungen
Das reichhaltige Angebot hat immer eine für Sie


VI. Das Museum hat eine Zyklusfreigabe bestimmter Rollen neu hinzugefügt.
Spezieller Hinweis:
Die spezifische Rolle ist eine Rolle, die in früheren Aktivitäten freigegeben wurde und derzeit nicht erhältlich ist.
Diese Rollen werden im Zyklus im Museum freigegeben.
Die spezifische Rolle dieses Zyklus ist: STT


VII. Neu hinzugefügter Dialog
1.Strv.74


VIII. Behobener Fehler
1. Es wurde der Fehler behoben, dass beim Freischalten und Aktualisieren von magischen Veränderungsfähigkeiten die Schnittstelle ein unzureichendes Niveau der gegnerischen Aufklärung anzeigt.

notes.title: 점검및 업데이트 공지
notes.content:
1.새로운 전차소녀
셔먼m4a3로켓발사기형(N5중형전차)


2.무술대길이벤트
군부에서 대량의 웨일스충견을 인입하였다. 만약 일정한 수량의 '뜨개실'을 수집하면 충견마크를 교환획득할 수 있으며, 순혈통인 웨일스충견을 획득한다.
이벤트 기간내'뜨개실'은 군항, 헌터스희무단, 특수미션, 쿠폰교환등 방식으로 획득가능. 


3.명절보급이벤트


4.새로운 여행자출시
33호 여행자(세번째 새로운 여행자)
'뜨개실'로 무순대길 이벤트 상점내에서 교환가능


5.새로운 스킨출시
외계미식가(미니 엡실론)
엡실론(원시상태)
두 스킨은 모두 "뜨개실"로 무술대길 이벤트에서 교환하거나 에테르 결정으로 교환가능합니다.


6.새로운 마크 3개 추가
일정한 수량의 전차소녀를 획득시 상점내 마크 출현


7.게임내 프랑스어및 아라비아어 지지.

notes.title: 21.06.2017 Aktualisieren
notes.content:
http://cdn.steamstatic.com.8686c.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28447584/044d2453d79936e9da88e329bd459a2c8e4f0e3b.png

21.06.2017 und 08-00 (UTC+2) wird aktualisiert, was die angenehmen Überraschungen beinhalten wird:
1. Unsere Reihen werden durch 5 neue Metall Mädchen verbunden sein
Der M551 Sheridan- ein leichter Panzer der Zeit des Kalten Krieges aus US-amerikanischer Produktion 
M48A3 (Höflichkeit)- Ein Trophäen-Tank, den Vietnam Mitte der 70er Jahre nach China präsentierte.
M7- Amerikanischer Mittlerer Panzer des Zweiten Weltkriegs
BM-21 "GRAD"- ist ein Mehrfachraketenwerfersystem, das in der Sowjetunion entwickelt wurde.
P 26/40- Der erste italienische Panzer in unseren Reihen!

2. Eine heiße Promotion beginnt!
21.06-31.07 Während der Veranstaltung, Für jeden "Versorgungen sind" – Schicksalswappen  als Geschenk!
Die Kommandanten, die früher "Versorgungen sind" gekauft haben, erhalten auch das verdiente Schicksalswappen (1 Medaillon für alle 30 Tage)
Kommandanten, die zum Zeitpunkt des Beginns der Veranstaltung mehr als 10 Tage "Versorgungen sind" haben, erhalten auch das Schicksalswappen. Kommandanten, die weniger als 10 Tage Versorgung haben, qualifizieren sich nicht für die Förderung.

Beispiel 1: Zum Zeitpunkt des Beginns des Ereignisses hast du noch 70 Tage nach dem "Versorgungen sind" - Du erhältst 3 Schicksalswappen 
(70 Tage = 60 + 10, 2 Schicksalswappen  für 60 Tage und 1 für die verbleibenden 10 Tage).

Beispiel 2: Zum Zeitpunkt des Beginns des Ereignisses hast du noch 65 Tage von der "Versorgungen sind" - Du erhältst 2 Schicksalswappen 
(65 Tage = 60 + 5, 2 Schicksalswappen in 60 Tagen, die restlichen 5 Tage Werden nicht gefördert).





Mit besten GRÜßEN, What ' s up game labs.
